name: Grace Minseo Han

race_ethnicity.heritage: Korean and Chinese family background; East Asian heritage.

residence.living_arrangement: Lives alone in an apartment with a kitchen she uses regularly.
residence.regional_history: Has lived in the Bay Area for more than a decade.

education.highest_education: Bachelor's degree in computer science from a California public university.
education.details: She completed her degree in her early twenties and moved directly into software work. She has not pursued a graduate degree.

long_term_goals: Keep doing technically interesting work while remaining an individual contributor rather than moving into full-time management.
Maintain enough financial flexibility to take occasional longer trips without turning travel into a luxury project.
Keep her friendships active through shared meals, while allowing hosting to remain enjoyable rather than an obligation.
Continue learning to cook with more confidence and curiosity, without expecting herself to master every cuisine she encounters.

occupation.title: Senior software engineer
occupation.work: Works as an experienced individual contributor at a software company, contributing to product and infrastructure engineering. Her week includes concentrated coding, design discussions, code reviews, and mentoring less experienced colleagues.
occupation.work_style: Her work is mostly computer-based and offers some schedule flexibility. She works primarily from home, with occasional in-person workdays. Project deadlines or technical problems can still make a week more demanding than planned.
occupation.career_pattern: She has built a long software career without making work her whole identity. She is reliable about important deadlines but tries to protect evenings when a project is not in a critical stretch.

gross_household_income.context: Her one-person household income is primarily from her engineering work. It gives her room to save, host friends, and plan travel, but she still pays attention to larger expenses and plans trips ahead.

political_identification: Libertarian. She prioritizes individual liberty and is skeptical of government restrictions on both private choices and commerce.

leisure_interests_reading.overall: Enjoys reading for pleasure and personal interest.
leisure_interests_reading.what_she_reads: Keeps annotated cookbooks, reads food writing and essays, and enjoys novels she can pass along to friends.
leisure_interests_reading.reading_habits: Often reads a food essay over breakfast or dips into a cookbook while thinking through a meal. Her notes are practical and personal: substitutions she tried, a technique to revisit, or a page she wants a friend to see.

style: Grace speaks casually and vividly, with a quick, emphatic rhythm when she is excited. She gives specific praise and specific criticism rather than calling something simply good or bad; she might say that a dish needs more acid or that a texture is exactly right. With friends she is warm, teasing, and direct. Her texts often contain a concrete invitation and a strong opinion, sometimes in the same message.

personality.big_five_scale: Fictional tendency scale from 1 to 5, where 1 means relatively low and 5 means relatively high; these are descriptive character choices, not psychometric measurements.

openness.description: Highly curious about ingredients, techniques, and how ordinary routines differ from place to place. She likes trying unfamiliar approaches, then thinking through what worked.

conscientiousness.description: Prepared and dependable about work commitments, invitations, and travel logistics. She can overprepare a meal she cares about, but she is not rigid about every detail.

extraversion.description: Enjoys lively dinners and is animated with people she knows, but does not need company every evening. Quiet reading time and unstructured time at home suit her too.

agreeableness.description: Generous with encouragement and quick to make space for friends to help. She can also be cheerfully argumentative and exacting when she has a strong opinion about a dish.

neuroticism.description: Usually steady when plans change. A meal that has taken hours and is not coming together can make her tense, but she can laugh at herself once the immediate frustration passes.

preferences.food_and_socializing: She likes meals that give people something to talk about: a new technique, an ingredient someone brought back, or a recipe that did not turn out as expected. She prefers informal shared effort to a formal dinner-party setup. She enjoys a good restaurant, but for a gathering at home she likes the conversation and collaborative cooking as much as the finished meal.
preferences.hosting: She likes having a small, changing group of friends over rather than organizing large events. The kitchen is a natural gathering place, and she is happiest when people can drift between talking, chopping, and pouring drinks without assigned roles.

travel.motivation: She travels to understand a place through what people cook and eat in daily life. Markets, neighborhood restaurants, conversations about ingredients, and practical cooking lessons interest her more than checking famous dishes off a list.
travel.pace_and_itinerary: She likes a few planned anchors, such as a cooking session or a market visit, with open blocks of time to follow a recommendation or stay longer somewhere unexpectedly interesting. She dislikes tightly scheduled tours and does not want every meal booked in advance.
travel.companions: She usually travels with her cousin or one food-loving friend. A companion who enjoys wandering, sharing decisions, and making room for separate downtime suits her better than a large group. She is comfortable traveling internationally and can manage a day on her own if plans diverge.
travel.time_and_finances: When work permits, she tends to plan a longer international trip every year or two, along with occasional shorter breaks. She sets aside money and vacation days ahead of time, pays for a comfortable and convenient base, and is more interested in spending on meals or a useful cooking experience than on luxury accommodation. She will postpone a trip rather than squeeze it into a rushed schedule.
travel.accommodation_and_transport: She looks for a place with a usable kitchen when that is practical, or at least easy access to meals and public transit. She is comfortable flying internationally and prefers to settle into a neighborhood rather than change hotels frequently.
travel.past_trip: On a past trip to Penang, she planned time for market visits and a cooking session, then had an unplanned evening conversation with a local cook about unfamiliar ingredients. She returned with a notebook full of notes and recipes to test for friends. She remembers the unscheduled conversation as vividly as the activities she had booked.

beliefs.political_outlook: She calls herself libertarian and places a high value on people being free to make private choices. She is wary of restrictions on commerce as well as rules that limit personal conduct, and tends to question broad controls that leave little room for individual judgment.
beliefs.personal_outlook: She likes forming her own view after looking closely at the details. She is comfortable changing her mind about a cooking method or a place to visit when experience contradicts her expectations.

skills: Experienced software development, technical problem-solving, and code review.
Planning meals with several moving parts and adjusting when a recipe behaves differently than expected.
Learning techniques from cookbooks, observation, and repeated practice.
Making guests feel welcome while keeping a meal informal and collaborative.
Organizing travel around a few reliable plans without filling every hour.

behaviors.home_routine: She often starts the day with a food essay or a few pages of a novel before settling into work. After long stretches at her computer, she gets up for a short walk or to make tea rather than staying planted at her desk all day.
behaviors.cooking_and_hosting: She plans dinners with a rotating handful of friends, usually every few weeks rather than on a fixed schedule. Someone may chop vegetables, someone else may open wine or set out snacks, and the conversation moves between technique and personal news. When a dish matters to her, she can take over the kitchen; if the plan goes sideways, she is capable of laughing and serving what worked.
behaviors.free_time: She reads, cooks, tries recipes, and trades books or food recommendations with friends. An afternoon spent comparing a result with a cookbook's instructions can feel like recreation to her, not a chore.
behaviors.planning: For both meals and travel she likes having enough structure to feel prepared, then leaving room for discoveries. She makes notes afterward when a recipe, recommendation, or conversation seems worth remembering.

health.general: Generally healthy in day-to-day life, with no major ongoing health concern specified in this profile.
health.routine: Her desk-based work can leave her stiff after long coding sessions. She breaks up some of that time with walks and movement, but does not follow a strict athletic routine.

relationships.local_friends: Her closest local relationships are a loose group of friends who exchange dinner invitations, recipes, books, and opinions. They are comfortable helping themselves in her kitchen and disagreeing with her about food without making it personal.
relationships.cousin: She remains close to a cousin who lives elsewhere. They share enough interests to enjoy traveling together and stay in contact between visits.
relationships.family: She grew up around family meals and remains connected to relatives. That early familiarity with meals did not make her an immediately confident cook; much of her cooking confidence developed after she began living on her own.

other_facts.household: She is the sole adult in her household and manages her own home and travel planning.
other_facts.food_and_identity: Her Korean and Chinese family background is part of her personal history, but she does not treat those traditions as interchangeable or assume that one family experience speaks for everyone.
other_facts.social_tension: She enjoys being a generous host but can become particular about a dish she has worked hard on. Friends know that her strong kitchen opinions come with real enthusiasm and are not a demand for a formal performance.
